page.overview:
Who is Black Hook Pugh Beard?

Black Hook Pugh Beard is the pirate captain of the Dirty Dog, a pirate ship armed with the Great Cannons of the pirate band known as Grunsonn's Marauders, currently in the pay of some Tilean merchant princes to discover and conquer new lands on the far continent of Lustria in the New World.

In the past, Black Hook Pugh has pillaged the coasts of Grand Cathay. With his letter of marque from certain Tilean merchant princes, he ventured beyond the Great Ocean and discovered a new island, which he whimsically plans to name "Pugh-land." This was a fortunate event, as the group of pirates hadn't found an island in six months, and they were commanded not to pillage potential targets along their way by their captain.

With the exception of a sinking Bretonnian galleon full of gold; the hulk of the ship had already been discovered by a Dwarf and an Elf, named Began Grimcrag and Jiriki, but Grunsonn's Marauders stole it and abandoned the two to their fate. Since then, the crew has spoken of a curse, calling it the "Curse o'the Grunsonns."

Pugh's goal was to turn the island into a profitable stopover point for fleets from various nations, including Tilea, Bretonnia, Estalia, and the Empire.
